note: Which ElevenLabs voice speaks for which character. The voiceId values stay empty until the owner has listened to auditions and chosen (M4 phase H). modelId must be the exact id of the model the owner picks in ElevenLabs; it is left empty rather than guessed.
_settingsNote: Sent explicitly with every line (voice_gen refuses settings without stability and similarity_boost), so nothing depends on the settings stored with a voice in the ElevenLabs account. 0.5 and 0.75 are ElevenLabs' API defaults and the values of round 1 of the diagnostic audition (docs/audio/voice-quality-diagnosis.md); the voice-and-sound-director sets the final values after round 2. A style's settings go on top of these, key by key. style and speed are never sent to a v4 model (v4 does not use them), so on eleven_v4 and eleven_v4_turbo the cheer is stability 0.1 only.
_priceNote: USD per 1,000 characters, list API prices (PLAN.md › costs), used only for the estimate that voice_gen plan prints. The owner's plan may differ; --price replaces them.
